انحلبن (form VII)
# اِنْحَلَبْنَ (inḥalabna) /in.ħa.lab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# اِنْحَلِبْنَ (inḥalibna) /in.ħa.lib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
